prior_importants.description: A nested package with its own yarn.lock and a committed Yarn Plug'n'Play runtime (Yarn Berry zero-install) has no node_modules by design. Before this PR its stages ran and it merged. Now the gate refuses it on every attempt, and the install it suggests never creates a node_modules, so the refusal can never clear.

findings.description: Any lockfile above a package that has none of its own is treated as that package's workspace root. For a standalone nested package that is not a workspace member and has no lockfile on disk, the refusal names the ancestor's install. That install never installs the package, so the gate refuses again with the same message every time. The stage itself runs npm in the package directory.

process_issues.description: Round 5 budget: spawned only correctness, security and guards. conventions, docs, simplicity, context and maintainability were skipped. spec had no source and workflow-safety had no workflow change. The consolidator was skipped because a single finding has nothing to group.
`bash scripts/adr-index.sh` needed approval and did not run. The reviewer found ADRs with Grep instead and did not open ADRs 95 or 138 directly.
